messages:
paula: FYI I hit a weird stall in the JS sample app when running large paginated imports behind our auth-proxy. It silently stops pulling pages after an auth burst.

ivan: Which SDK + sample? Any logs?

paula: js-sdk@2.6, sampleapps/importer, concurrency=10, pageWindow=300. Logs show the request acquires a slot then triggers a token refresh. After refresh completes the slot is not returned to the pool and everything stalls. Snippet:
```
2027-01-11T10:05:01.100Z DEBUG pager: slot-acquire id=112
2027-01-11T10:05:01.102Z DEBUG transport -> /v1/items id=112 401
2027-01-11T10:05:01.103Z DEBUG auth: refresh coordinator start (coord-id=7)
2027-01-11T10:05:01.350Z DEBUG auth: refresh done tok=tok_9
2027-01-11T10:05:01.351Z DEBUG pager: waiting on-slot-return (id=112)
// then nothing
```

kim: Hmm. Sounds like the refresh path is doing a synchronous token handoff while still holding the slot. If the refresh handler also tries to manipulate slot bookkeeping (e.g., requeue), it can deadlock the slot owner.

rachel: We saw a similar symptom in Go but the root cause was different: retry queuing behavior caused a refill spike that starved other workers. Two independent issues can look the same.

ivan: Proposed fixes: (A) ensure token refresh never touches slot state and runs outside the slot critical path, (B) introduce a lightweight retry-buffer that re-enqueues failed pages without reacquiring slots immediately, and (C) add a slot-hold timeout that emits a diagnostic and optionally force-frees the slot (opt-in).

paula: I prefixed a quick patch: move refresh to a background coordinator and mark the page as "awaiting-auth" so the slot is yielded immediately. Patch removed the hang in my local run.

kim: For SDK parity: align browser/node/go behavior by adding an auth.refreshCoordinator util in core-auth and a retry-buffer primitive in core-pager. Tests: unit test for refresh coordinator single-run under N callers; e2e that simulates 401 bursts and asserts progress continues to completion with zero duplicated page IDs.

rachel: Also recommend adding a default retryMode: "buffered" so new users don't hit this unexpectedly; advanced users can opt into low-latency "immediate" retries. Update onboarding docs with recommended settings for bulk imports.

paula: Opening PR with minimal repro and tests. Will include metrics: pager.slot_hold_seconds and pager.duplicate_pages_count. Tagging @kim and @ivan for review.
